title: Lucifer, dico, qui nescit occasum.
html_source: “Lucifer, I say, who knows no setting.”

anchor.prefix:
r trial. We enjoyed ourselves immensely. 

 Come. I thirst. Clouding over. No black clouds anywhere, are there? Thunderstorm. Allbright he falls, proud lightning of the intellect,
anchor.suffix:
No. My cockle hat and staff and hismy sandal shoon. Where? To evening lands. Evening will find itself. 

 He took the hilt of his ashplant, lunging with it softly, dallying still.
